name: @starkware-libs/anystark-core
description: Framework-agnostic core for connecting a Phantom (Solana) wallet as a Starknet account: address derivation, Ed25519 signer, Phantom provider, and a counterfactual sol_account with sponsored (SNIP-29) execution.

size-limit.name: @starkware-libs/anystark-core import cost (boot path; garaga excluded, kept lazy by check:lazy). Includes @noble/curves ed25519, imported eagerly to validate a pubkey (on-curve, not small-order) before deriving its address. [measured 13.67 kB, limit rounded up for headroom]

@starkware-libs/anystark-core tree-shaking smoke: single symbol deriveSolAccountAddress, garaga excluded (guards against tree-shaking breaking). Carries the eager @noble/curves ed25519 key validation. [measured 9.73 kB, limit catches a >~13% regression]

garaga lazy chunk size (INFORMATIONAL, non-gating: no limit set): first-signature-only WASM (base64-inlined), NOT the boot path; measures the shipped garaga module a consumer's bundler code-splits. Path assumes garaga is workspace-hoisted to root node_modules (../../node_modules/garaga). [measured 607.32 kB, ~2.6 MB raw]
